title: 第26章要来了第27章凝气八重
content_zh:
因为说这句话的人是方圆。三天之内从凝气一重到七重的人，说“十四天从凝气一重到三重”，已经是极其保守的估计了。
“能做到吗？”方圆问。
方铭咬了咬牙：“能。”
“好。”方圆转头看向方正阳，“家主，方家还有多少凝气丹？”
方正阳想了想：“库存大约十五枚。”
“全部拿出来。方铭三枚，其余七名参赛弟子每人一枚，剩下的留着备用。”
方正阳点头，让方七去库房取丹药。
方圆又看向王紫璇：“王家那边，你来安排。我需要王家的参赛弟子名单，三天之内给我。”
“没问题。”王紫璇点头，转身出门。
她又走了几步，突然停下来，回头看着方圆，嘴唇动了动，似乎想说什么。
方圆看着她。
“你……保重。”王紫璇说完，快步走了。
方圆看着她的背影消失在门口，嘴角微微动了一下，然后收回目光，继续安排方家的备战。
“家主，我需要一间修炼室，灵气越浓越好。”
方正阳想了想：“方家后山有一处温泉，地下的灵气浓度是外面的三倍。但你用了之后，方家其他人就用不了了。”
“让他们去别处。这十四天，我要独占温泉。”
方正阳看了他一眼，没有犹豫，点头：“好。”
方圆转身走出正堂。
他没有回自己的院子，而是直接去了后山。
温泉在后山半山腰的一处凹陷中，周围是茂密的竹林。温泉不大，只有三丈见方，水温适中，常年有热气蒸腾，空气中弥漫着淡淡的硫磺味。

但方圆来这里不是为了泡温泉。
他脱下外袍和靴子，只穿着一身单衣，走进温泉中央，盘膝坐下。水没到他的胸口，热气包围了他的全身。
他的灵识展开，探索着温泉下方的灵气来源。
温泉下方大约十丈处，有一条小型的灵脉。灵脉不粗，但很纯，灵气浓度是外面的三到五倍。对方圆来说，这就够了。
他闭上眼睛，开始运转《玄帝不灭经》第三层。
第三层的经文在他的识海中缓缓旋转，每一个字都散发着金色的光芒。前世的记忆中，第三层修炼到大成之后，可以在体内凝聚“不灭金身”——一种肉身防御力暴涨的状态，刀枪不入，水火不侵，甚至能硬抗高出自己一个大境界的攻击而不死。
方圆现在离“大成”还很远。
他刚刚突破第三层，只掌握了基本的不灭之力。距离凝聚不灭金身，至少还需要在生死之间再走三次。
但他不打算再走生死了。
太危险了。三次濒死，每一次都有可能真的死掉。前三次他已经赌赢了，第四次、第五次、第六次，赌赢的概率会越来越低。
他需要一种更安全的方法来提升实力。
前世的记忆告诉他——灵气的“量”不够，可以用“质”来补。别人的灵气是铁，他的灵气是钢。钢的数量不如铁，但硬度是铁的十倍。他不需要在“量”上和别人比，他要在“质”上碾压对手。
方圆闭目内视，观察自己体内的灵气。
突破到凝气境七重之后，他体内的灵气已经完全变成了淡金色。每一丝灵气都像是被压缩过无数次的重水，密度大得惊人。普通凝气境七重的武者，一拳打出能有一千斤的力量。但他的一拳——至少三千斤。
这是三倍的差距。
如果他能将灵气进一步压缩，从“淡金”压到“纯金”，那么他的每一拳都能达到五千斤以上。凝气境七重打出五千斤的力量，可以媲美凝气境九重巅峰的全力一击，甚至不输给筑基境一重的普通攻击。
方圆深吸一口气。
温泉下方的灵气被他疯狂地吸入体内，他的身体像一个无底洞，吞食着每一条流动的灵气。灵气入体后不经过经脉，直接进入血肉骨骼，被《玄帝不灭经》一层层压缩、提纯、再压缩、再提纯。
半个时辰后，方圆体内的灵气从“淡金”变成了“金黄”。
凝气境七重中期。
content_en:
Because the person who said this is Fangyuan. For someone who went from the first level of Qi Condensation to the seventh level in three days, saying "from the first level to the third level of Qi Condensation in fourteen days" is already an extremely conservative estimate.
"Can it be done?" Fangyuan asked.
Fang Ming gritted his teeth: "Yes."
"Okay." Fang Yuan turned to look at Fang Zhengyang, "Master, how many Qi Condensing Pills does the Fang family have?"
Fang Zhengyang thought for a while: "There are about fifteen coins in stock."
"Take them all out. Three for Fang Ming, one for each of the other seven participating disciples, and keep the rest for later use."
Fang Zhengyang nodded and asked Fang Qi to go to the warehouse to get the elixir.
Fangyuan looked at Wang Zixuan again: "On the Wang family's side, you make the arrangements. I need the list of participating disciples from the Wang family, give it to me within three days."
"No problem." Wang Zixuan nodded, turned around and went out.
She walked a few more steps, stopped suddenly, looked back at Fang Yuan, and moved her lips, as if she wanted to say something.
Fangyuan looked at her.
"You...take care." Wang Zixuan finished speaking and walked away quickly.
Fang Yuan watched her disappear from the door, the corner of her mouth moved slightly, then withdrew her gaze and continued to arrange the Fang family's preparations for the war.
"Master, I need a training room. The stronger the spiritual energy, the better."
Fang Zhengyang thought for a while: "There is a hot spring in the mountains behind the Fang family. The concentration of spiritual energy underground is three times that of the outside. But after you use it, other people in the Fang family will not be able to use it."
"Let them go elsewhere. I will have the hot spring to myself for these fourteen days."
Fang Zhengyang glanced at him and nodded without hesitation: "Okay."
Fangyuan turned around and walked out of the main hall.
Instead of going back to his yard, he went directly to the back mountain.
The hot spring is in a depression halfway up the back mountain, surrounded by dense bamboo forests. The hot spring is not big, only three feet square, the water temperature is moderate, steam is evaporating all year round, and the air is filled with a faint smell of sulfur.
But Fangyuan didn't come here just to soak in the hot springs.
He took off his robe and boots, wearing only a single suit, walked into the center of the hot spring, and sat down cross-legged. The water was up to his chest, and heat enveloped his whole body.
His spiritual consciousness unfolded and he explored the source of spiritual energy under the hot spring.
About ten feet below the hot spring, there is a small spiritual vein. The spiritual veins are not thick, but very pure, and the concentration of spiritual energy is three to five times that of the outside. For the circle, that's enough.
He closed his eyes and began to operate the third level of "Xuan Emperor Immortality Sutra".
The scriptures on the third level slowly rotated in his sea of ​​consciousness, and every word exuded golden light. In the memory of the past life, after the third level of cultivation is completed, the "Immortal Golden Body" can be condensed in the body - a state in which the body's defense power skyrockets, making it invulnerable to weapons and bullets, water and fire, and even capable of resisting attacks from a level higher than itself without dying.
Fangyuan is still far from "Dacheng".
He had just broken through the third level and had only mastered the basic immortal power. The distance to condense the immortal golden body requires at least three more walks between life and death.
But he doesn't plan to live or die anymore.
It's too dangerous. Three near-death experiences, each time there was a possibility of real death. He has won the first three bets, and the fourth, fifth, and sixth times, the probability of winning will become lower and lower.
He needed a safer way to increase his strength.
The memory of his previous life told him that if the "quantity" of spiritual energy was not enough, he could use "quality" to make up for it. Others' spiritual energy is iron, while his spiritual energy is steel. There is less steel than iron, but it is ten times harder. He doesn't need to compare with others in terms of "quantity", he wants to crush his opponents in terms of "quality".
Fangyuan closed her eyes and looked inside, observing the spiritual energy in her body.
After breaking through to the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm, the spiritual energy in his body had completely turned into pale gold. Every trace of spiritual energy is like heavy water that has been compressed countless times, and its density is astonishingly high. An ordinary warrior at the seventh level of the Qi Condensation Realm can punch a force of one thousand kilograms. But his punch - at least three thousand pounds.
That's three times the difference.
If he can further compress the spiritual energy from "light gold" to "pure gold", then heEach punch can reach more than 5,000 kilograms. A person at the seventh level of the Qi Condensation Realm can hit a force of five thousand kilograms, which is comparable to a full-strength blow from the ninth level of the Qi Condensation Realm, and is not even inferior to a normal attack at the first level of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Fangyuan took a deep breath.
The spiritual energy under the hot spring was madly inhaled into his body, and his body was like a bottomless pit, swallowing every flowing spiritual energy. After the spiritual energy enters the body, it does not pass through the meridians, but directly enters the flesh and bones. It is compressed, purified, re-compressed, and purified layer by layer by the "Xuan Emperor Immortality Sutra".
Half an hour later, the spiritual energy in Fangyuan's body changed from "light gold" to "golden".
The middle stage of the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm.
